meta.title: Video Cutter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Pick a local video with start/end times and cut it entirely in the browser — no upload required.
desc: Pick a local video with start/end times and cut it entirely in the browser — no upload required.
ui.1: Click to select a video, or drag a video file here
ui.2: Supports mp4 / mov / webm / m4v formats
ui.8: Tip: play to the target position and click the corresponding button to auto-fill the current time (accurate to 0.1 s).
ui.13: Cut complete, preview or download the result
ui.20: End time exceeds the video duration (
ui.22: Current playback position set as end time
ui.23: Current playback position set as start time
ui.24: Video loaded, drag the player to locate the cut points
ui.29: Loading the video processing engine (the first load may take tens of seconds)...
ui.100: Engine script error, please refresh the page and retry
ui.101: Engine load failed: cannot connect to the script service, please check your network and refresh the page
ui.102: File too large (over 800MB), the browser may run out of memory, please use a smaller video
ui.103: Please select a video file first
ui.104: Invalid start time, please enter a number not less than 0
ui.105: Invalid end time, please enter a number not less than 0
ui.106: Start time must be earlier than end time
ui.107: The video is processed only in your local browser and nothing is uploaded; cutting uses lossless copy, which is fast and preserves quality, and the in/out points are snapped to the nearest keyframes.
ui.netErr: Network error, please check your connection and refresh
ui.notReady: Processing engine not ready, please refresh the page
ui.stillLoading: Processing engine is still loading, please try again later
